correctness.rationale: Computed four-variable generalized Vandermonde determinant symbolically for row exponents (0,1,3,4), independently matching Vandermonde*e2. For four distinct Nth roots a zero minor is exactly six products summing to zero. Lam--Leung weight theorem excludes six when gcd(N,6)=1; if 2|N, four distinct roots (1,t,t^2,-t) give e2=0, and if 3|N, (1,u,u^2,t) give zero. Verified index distinctness through N=600 with N>=6, plus exact residues mod 2,3,4 and d>=5 for uniformity. All-orders proof rests on theorem and constructions, not finite checks.
residual_risks: No unsupported infinite extrapolation from finite replay.

evidence: Lam--Leung weight 6 obstruction applies when smallest prime divisor is 5 or greater; the general full-spark paper proves divisor uniformity necessary and prime-power sufficiency, not the fixed pattern all-N classification.
